snippet.title: Microsoft Baseball 2000 - Yankees vs Red Sox
snippet.description:
The first three innings on Microsoft Baseball 2000 at Yankee Stadium with the New York Yankees vs Boston Red Sox.  I simply put the computers up against themselves and let it play out.  Sorry about the black boxes over the text It probably has to do with the game being from 1999 and it running on modern hardware/Windows 10.  I never know the score, what pitch I'm throwing, or the player stats etc...  If anyone knows how to fix that PLEASE let me know.

Microsoft Baseball 2000 is a sports video game developed by WizBang! Software Productions and published by Microsoft. It was released for Microsoft Windows in 1999, as an updated version of Microsoft Baseball 3D 1998 Edition.
